shielded.label: Shields
shielded.subtitle: Energy bubble
shielded.description: Blue energy bubble. Absorbs damage before HP. Pool size scales with the host kind.

healAura.label: Healers
healAura.subtitle: Field medic
healAura.description: Pulsing green ring. Heals nearby allies for 3 HP/sec within 3.5 tiles.

regen.label: Regen
regen.subtitle: Self-heal
regen.description: Floating mint-green '+'. Passive 1.5 HP/sec while not taking damage.

slow.label: Slow
slow.subtitle: Speed debuff
slow.description: Applied only by Cryo Emitter. Reduces movement speed for the slow duration.

adaptation.label: Adaptation
adaptation.subtitle: Evolved resistance
adaptation.description: Lean too hard on one damage type and the herd evolves. Starting at level 12, a share of each wave spawns with hardened resistance against the damage type you've dealt the most over the last 3 waves — the more concentrated your portfolio, the higher the share and the deeper the resistance (up to effective immunity). Adapted spawns carry an off-color body tint so you can read the threat at a glance. Counter: diversify your towers or lean on a T3 anti-modifier branch.
